problem.title: L-LO KITTI Odom seq 00 full (4541 frames): ground-height-map vertical mode
problem.question: Does the opt-in ground-height-map vertical estimate (pitch_mode 3, not in the paper) change full-sequence accuracy with the fixed seq07_tuned horizontal setting?

variants.label: Seq 07 tuned (fresh reference)
variants.intent: Fixed Table 6 setting (cluster_cell 0.25, ground_tolerance 0.15, max_range 80), rerun on the same binary as the candidate.

variants.label: Seq 07 tuned + ground-height-map vertical (not in the paper)
variants.intent: Same horizontal setting; height, pitch and roll against a 30-frame world ground-height map (pitch_mode 3). Opt-in, default off.
